reviews.review: its an ok game could be better

It was an ordinary day in my life, a few months after my girlfriend left me, I came across Warframe. She smiled at me and asked "Do you wanna be a SpaceNinja? It is fun being a SpaceNinja.". Desperate to find a cure for my broken heart, I gave it a shot. Warframe was right, being a SpaceNinja is fun.

Days, weeks, months passed, I no longer think of my of my ex-girlfriend. Everyday I look forward spending time with Warframe instead. She looks good, she is creative, she is action-packed, she's very adventurous. She made me feel needed by the universe. She made me feel strong. She made me feel special.

She's not the typical girlfriend. She didn't demand much money so she can be a better girlfriend to me. All she wanted was my time. She asked for money only when I wanted a new Space Suit, and only when I needed a new shelf for my SpaceNinja toys.  You can choose to spend on her, but trust me, it isn't necessary. You don't have to pay to win her love.

Warframe is probably the perfect girl, whose only flaw is that she is overly-attached. She's all I wanted to be with, but it came to a point when she started asking so much of my time so that we can do the very same thing we were already doing for a year. She wanted me to get her this resource, then that resource, then another, so I can craft more SpaceNinja stuff, which eventually will be worth nothing but a SpaceNinja trophy in my shelf. I felt the pressure. I felt strangled. It was repetitive. It was tiring. Then is when I realized, I needed a break.

We didn't see each other for a few weeks. It was strange because I loved her so much but I never felt the need to see her again. I miss her sometimes, yes. She said she misses me too. And so we decided to be just friends. Now we see each other every now and then, but no more commitments. I think it is better this way. Enjoying each other's company, without the pressure of doing so much for her. 

Warframe, indeed, is good for casual fun. But the moment you take it seriously and love it more than you should, then is when you'll realize that she demands so much more than you can give. Then is when you'll fall out of love right away and realize that all those work are for a relationship that you will be soon leaving.

If you wanna make a serious long-term relationship with someone, go on, Warframe is the one to be with.  But if you're the type who gets bored easily by doing the exact same thing for no real purpose, find someone else to love.

I still recommend her though. Because she, at least, does her best to give you the fun you deserve.

It's addictive, fun to play with friends if you enjoy co-op, and is a good example of Free-to-play done well. If you end up investing in the game you'll want to put some cash down to improve your experience however, as the number of weapons and 'classes' or warframe you can store on your account is overlly limited without paying (or trading in-game items, which is also a viable option).
Warframe, omg don't even get me started! In my honest opinion this game is just un real. You have such a diversity in choice it's incredible it's and amazing fps/rpg!
